2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

df_product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().reset_index()
df_product_revenue = df_product_revenue.sort_values('total', ascending=False)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='total', y='product', data=df_product_revenue, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Total Revenue by Product')
plt.xlabel('Total Revenue ($)')
plt.ylabel('Product')
plt.tight_layout()
